meta.name: Circuito de Navarra
meta.description: Circuito de Navarra, Main Track (4.30 km), Medium (2.65 km) and Short (1.32 km) layouts from OpenStreetMap, with heights, camber and terrain from the Gobierno de Navarra's 2024 LIDAR DTM (2 m). Dry northern-Spain hills of scrub and bare ground beside Los Arcos.

imported.source: Layout and woodland (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Heights: MDT 2 m 2024 from the LiDAR de Navarra 2024, Servicio proporcionado por el Gobierno de Navarra (IDENA), CC BY 4.0. Widths: Servicio proporcionado por el Gobierno de Navarra (IDENA), LiDAR 2024, CC BY 4.0. Run-off, barriers and trees: measured from Gobierno de Navarra LiDAR 2024 (CC BY 4.0) and OpenStreetMap (ODbL), barrier types from published track guides (tools/real_tracks_data/runoff_evidence.json).
